professionalSummary.text: Seasoned Site Project Coordinator with three years of experience managing construction schedules, daily site diaries, and progress reporting for utility‑scale solar farm projects.
professionalSummary.witness: "Site project coordinator on two utility‑scale solar farm sites for a construction contractor over three years, keeping the construction schedule current each week with the four subcontractors' reported progress."

experienceHighlights.text: Maintained up‑to‑date construction schedules weekly, reflecting subcontractor progress across four key trades.
experienceHighlights.witness: "keeping the construction schedule current each week with the four subcontractors' reported progress."

experienceHighlights.text: Recorded daily site diaries and permit‑to‑work registers in accordance with site procedures, audited quarterly with no findings.
experienceHighlights.witness: "Recorded the daily site diary and the permit-to-work register under the site procedures, with both audited quarterly by the site health and safety adviser without findings."

experienceHighlights.text: Prepared weekly progress reports for the developer's site representative, including comments and filing in the site folder.
experienceHighlights.witness: "Prepared the weekly progress report for the developer's site representative, with the reports and the representative's comments filed in the site folder."

experienceHighlights.text: Tracked material deliveries against the schedule, resolving supplier queries and escalating necessary site instructions.
experienceHighlights.witness: "Tracked the material deliveries against the schedule in the delivery log, recording which delivery queries I resolved with the suppliers and which needed the site project manager's site instruction."

experienceHighlights.text: Authored hand‑over condition notes at mechanical completion and grid connection milestones, countersigned by the site project manager.
experienceHighlights.witness: "Wrote the hand-over condition notes at the mechanical completion and grid connection milestones on both sites, countersigned by the site project manager."

projectsAndWorkSamples.text: Provided work samples including a month’s schedule updates, a week’s site diary and permit‑to‑work register pages, a weekly progress report, and a milestone hand‑over note, with verifiable site folder references.
projectsAndWorkSamples.witness: "Work sample: one month's schedule updates, one week's site diary and permit-to-work register pages, one weekly progress report and one milestone hand-over note, with the site folder references as a verification trail."
